# GitHub Copilot Instructions for github-slideshow

This repository is a GitHub Learning Lab slideshow project built with Jekyll and reveal.js.

## Project Overview
- This is a presentation/slideshow repository for learning GitHub basics
- Built with Jekyll static site generator
- Uses reveal.js for slide presentation functionality
- Configured for GitHub Pages deployment

## Coding Standards
- Follow Ruby and Jekyll best practices
- Maintain YAML configuration format in `_config.yml`
- Keep slide content in Markdown format in the `_posts/` directory
- Use semantic file naming: slides should be named `YYYY-MM-DD-title.md` format
- Preserve existing reveal.js configuration settings

## Dependencies
- Ruby (for Jekyll)
- Jekyll static site generator
- reveal.js presentation framework
- jemoji plugin for emoji support

## Testing
- Ensure YAML files are valid before committing
- Test Jekyll builds locally when making configuration changes
- Verify slide rendering in browser

## Style Guidelines
- Use Markdown for slide content
- Follow existing indentation and formatting in YAML files
- Keep code comments minimal and only when necessary
- Use semantic HTML when needed in slides
